meta.base_model: models/Building_I/BI_presentation_v009.blend (v008 approved geometry + v009 materials; v009 not approved, frozen pre-v010)
meta.units: decimal feet, Building I coordinates (origin grid 1 x grid A at FFE 661.75); z in the model = elevation - 661.75
controlling_sources: CS-101 Dimension Control Plan rev 13 SITE FURNISHINGS RFI 07.22.25 (PCO 17 - RFI 58, p.10), 1 in = 20 ft: curb lines (stroke 6 pt black, face of curb / back of curb 1.5 ft apart), written dimensions and radii

CG-101 Grading & Drainage Plan, RFI 78 07.29.25 (PCO 24 p.11) and Blythe COR 29 Revised Canopy Grades 10/15/2025 (PCO 50 p.4 1 in = 20 ft, p.5 EXHIBIT 1 1 in = 10 ft): spot elevations TOC/BOC/HP, storm structures
LP-101 Landscape Plan rev 13 07.22.25 (PCO 24 p.13): island planting (11 EMRA in the oval), paved nose unplanted, plant beds along the walks
A1.13 Entry Canopy Plans (Rev 14 p.29): canopy 78 ft x 23 ft 5 in, gutter on G.2, columns at 12 ft o.c. (unchanged, preserved)
A0.01 Architectural Site Plan (Rev 14 p.8): shows the same loop, island and plaza (secondary check only)
Photographs 2026-07-28 (drone a): loop with planted oval island and paved nose, canopy over the drop-off lane - validation only
meta.registration: CS-101 Dimension Control Plan rev 13 07.22.25 (PCO 17 p.10), 1 in = 20 ft, registration x_BI = 141 + (X - 1859)/3.6, y_BI = 173.53 - (Y - 1211.1)/3.6 (v003 court-sideline fit); curb linework = stroke 6 pt black; the two parallel curb lines are 1.5 ft apart (face of curb = pavement side, back of curb = walk side)

regrade_window.note: terrain cells regenerated from the cleaned spot set inside this window only; outside it the v003 terrain is untouched (top edge 210 ft so the two LP-100 parking-lot islands at y 213-228 stay untouched); east edge 110 ft (inside the building for y 74-203) so the second storm chart's influence does not leave a step at the window edge

meta.spot_elevation_correction: 42 'SPOT' entries of the v003 set (655.40-660.12) are the Rim/Invert values of the two STORM DRAINAGE CHART tables printed over the entrance area of CG-101 (PCO 24 p.11 / PCO 50 p.4); they are not grades. They are removed here; TOC/BOC/HP entries inside the same rectangles are genuine and kept.
meta.drive_merged_note: outer contour of (v003 polygon minus the region x > -45 & y < 162) union drive_new_region, rasterised at 0.25 ft with a 3x3 morphological opening, simplified 0.25 ft, spikes removed; 248 vertices, 27277 sq ft (the island and the end island are separate raised objects on top)
meta.spot_correction_2: v010 trial render showed a cone in the paved nose: the 656.00 'TOC' spot at (6.44,125.92) is the roof-drain pipe label '656.00 (WYE-100)' on the PCO 50 CG-101 bulletin (the label sits on the TOC: 661.36 / BOC: 660.86 line). Every harvested value immediately followed by a '(STRUCTURE)' word is a pipe invert / connection elevation, not a surface grade: dropped (list spots_dropped_pipe_inverts)

grade_fields.G_gutter_pavement: IDW 1/d^3 of: TOC-0.50, BOC, unlabeled spot inside the drive polygon, unlabeled spot outside -0.50 (ground = curb-top level)
grade_fields.fade: both fields blend into the plain IDW of the same cleaned set over the outer 8 ft of the regrade window so the untouched v003 terrain is met continuously (the curb height fades to 0 there)

meta.slab_mesh: every new slab: regular grid (4 ft drive, 3 ft others) clipped to the outline with the exact boolean (INTERSECT with the ear-clip prism), then z from the field: no long thin fan triangles

SITE_asphalt_west_drive_dropoff.polygon: union of the v003 polygon restricted to (x <= -45 or y >= 162) with drive_new_region (rasterised at 0.25 ft, outer contour)
SITE_asphalt_west_drive_dropoff.zfunc: gutter IDW (TOC spots lowered 0.5 ft) + dz

SITE_entry_island_oval_bed_CS101.note: 6 in curb implied by the raised slab edge; planted with the documented EMRA row (LP-100 callout 11)

SITE_walk_canopy_plaza_pavers_CS101.note: paver hatch on CS-101 from the back of curb to the vestibule / lobby / north-block faces; the east walk (7.00' + 1.5 ft curb top = 8.5 ft, x 51.7-60.5) runs north to the loading zone; the planting bed x 60.5-71 (LP-101 rows DOUB/LAMB/SNOW/VANG/ILST/BLON) starts at y 100

SITE_walk_diagonal_pavers_CS101.note: 7.00 ft band along the diagonal curb

SITE_walk_aisle_concrete_CS101.note: 8.00 / 8.50 ft walk south of the drive-aisle curb, x -111.8 to the diagonal

SITE_terrain_IDW_INTERPOLATED.method: 4 ft cells (top = T field, boundary vertices keep the v003 heights) built as a closed 2 ft slab, exact boolean DIFFERENCE with the pavement solids (drive face-of-curb prism, plaza, diagonal walk, aisle walk, v003 entry plaza), joined back to the untouched terrain; bottom faces removed
SITE_terrain_IDW_INTERPOLATED.note: no terrain face can rise through a pavement slab; the cut edge lies under the curb ring / slab sides

SITE_curb_entrance_drive_CS101.polygon: ring between drive_merged (face of curb) and its 1.5 ft outward miter offset (back of curb), clipped to the regrade window
SITE_curb_entrance_drive_CS101.note: CS-101 double curb line 1.5 ft apart (V); TOC - BOC = 0.50 (CG-101, W); the terrain is cut at the face of curb and the ring covers the 1.5 ft strip; miter limited to 1.5 x width at sharp corners

landscape_rule: every LS_/CTX_existing object whose bounding box intersects the regrade window is rebuilt with the v004/v007/v008 builder at its documented x,y and the corrected grade; x,y never change; every plant's z_old -> z_new is recorded
